actual_scope: Execute a separately versioned two-path-key successor of the selected PR1094 final stage on native Windows, using archived hash-bound PR1042 local inputs; compare all 105 outputs and validate changed receipt hash links.
scope_change_reason: Live PR2316 explicitly requests a successor execution after inventory admission. The first P104 candidate was abandoned before research because fresh overlap showed its terminal-cut floor and several chronological models already covered. This is a deliberate portable-replay handoff override, not a random allocation or new P104 result.
bottleneck_link: Verifier engineering side result: distinguish Windows serialization differences from changed proof content in the selected supplier final-stage replay. This does not improve the binding complex budget.
stop_rule: One final-stage replay and full output comparison; stop on an unexplained difference. No cold ancestry, supplier redesign, frozen-source edits, or selected-frontier changes.
evidence: VALIDATION.json records native Windows CPython 3.12.14 execution, original guard failure, all eleven successor strict stages, 105-file comparison, and deliberate corruption rejections.
